tool_args.rationale: The discriminating probe adds wide s_grad leverage needed to identify the siphon parameters and local branch without clipping rho to the narrow warm-start box.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The narrow s_grad range leaves vmax and rho nearly collinear and cannot reliably distinguish branch completions.
The ambiguity concerns gradient leverage and branch identity, not temporal resolution.
It does not address the identified ambiguity.
